input_snapshot.scope: Root receipt alone plus six selected canonical originals; no recursive history or transitive expansion.

hypotheses: Compatible first-provider return, zero EAX selected by the accepted TEST/JZ path, and ESP=S-4 before the zero-arm PUSH.
Ordinary legacy x86 with 32-bit operand/address sizes and SS.B=1; modulo-2^32 pointer arithmetic with each complete access separately valid.
Ordinary little-endian RAM; stable relevant descriptors, translations and backing identities; successful reads, writes, control-transfer checks and applicable reached instruction fetches.
No external or asynchronous intervening write; no extra control-protection effect; no self-modifying-code scenario that invalidates the accepted reached encodings.
Each ordinary four-byte store and read has four distinct byte positions; no atomicity, cross-thread store order, fault, MMIO or runtime mapping claim.
rho(L)=(phi(L)-CS.base) mod 2^32 denotes the conditional runtime CPU offset of saved listing label L; valid compatible code mapping is assumed, not observed.

stack_footprints.S: Entry ESP of the accepted BF66EF body
stack_footprints.L: F(S-8): literal-two slot / later POP ECX source
stack_footprints.B: F(S-4): saved-EBP slot / later POP EBP source
stack_footprints.C: F(S): current caller return word at the final tail
stack_footprints.A_k: F(S+4*k), k=1..5: current outgoing five-word prefix

ordered_memory.N: Memory before the zero-arm PUSH 2, including all first-provider effects
ordered_memory.M0: store(store(N,L,2),R,t), where store is the completed ordinary four-byte little-endian store
ordered_memory.AND: Read the complete four-byte operand, compute value AND zero, then write four zero bytes
ordered_memory.M1: M1[b]=0 if b belongs to W; otherwise M0[b]
ordered_memory.prior_write_alias_qualification: The last CALL store establishes R=t, but if stack footprints alias it may change the earlier literal, saved EBP, caller return or outgoing argument bytes. Their actual values remain in M0; offset inequality alone is not a proof of disjoint backing.

exact_predicates.P(F,v): For every j: if F[j] is in W then byte_j(v)=0; otherwise M0[F[j]]=byte_j(v). This is equivalent to word(M1,F)=v.
exact_predicates.preserve_own_pre_AND_value: word(M1,F)=word(M0,F) iff every overlapping pre-AND byte M0[F[j]] with F[j] in W was already zero.
exact_predicates.intended_return: P(R,t), together with normal RET checks and applicable continuation fetch, gives EIP=t and ESP=S-8.
exact_predicates.ECX_two: Conditional on that return and successful continuation, ECX=2 iff P(L,2). If word(M0,L)=2, only its low 02 byte must avoid the clear; high zero bytes may overlap harmlessly.
exact_predicates.saved_EBP: Conditional on the continuation, EBP equals desired earlier b iff P(B,b). Preserving M0's saved word does not prove restoration of original entry EBP unless earlier effects are also accounted for.
exact_predicates.caller_return: The tail's current caller return word equals c iff P(C,c).
exact_predicates.outgoing_value: The tail's current argument k equals a_k iff P(A_k,a_k).
exact_predicates.outgoing_zero: word(M1,A_k)=0 iff every byte of A_k outside W was zero in M0.

conditional_continuation.ESP: S-8 after EF3 RET, S-4 after POP ECX, S after POP EBP
conditional_continuation.tail_EIP: rho(00BF65BB), under the compatible direct-jump mapping and fetch conditions
conditional_continuation.EAX: Retains conditioned zero-arm input zero through these local instructions; no return type or ABI follows
conditional_continuation.arithmetic_flags: AND sets CF=OF=SF=0, ZF=PF=1 and undefined AF; RET, POP ECX, POP EBP and JMP preserve those arithmetic flags in this normal model
conditional_continuation.no_implicit_restore: RET does not restore EBP; explicit POP EBP reads current memory.

initial_zero_boundary.outer_relation: For the accepted BF6713 wrapper, let U be its entry ESP; its child entry has S=U-24 and five initially zero words under the corresponding successful ordered-store conditions.
initial_zero_boundary.later_state: First-provider and intervening local write effects are included in N and M0. Initial zeros are not immutable values or guaranteed tail arguments.
initial_zero_boundary.clear_limit: A nonzero first-provider byte outside W survives. A nonzero byte inside W becomes zero. The AND cannot create a nonzero byte from zero and does not universally re-zero all five words.
initial_zero_boundary.final_target: No final tail-target return, cleanup, preservation or ABI contract is inferred.
